No.93 Ballygossan Park is a truly exceptional four-bedroom semi-detached family residence, meticulously presented and finished to an exacting standard throughout. Combining timeless elegance with contemporary design, this beautifully appointed home offers an outstanding level of comfort, style and functionality, creating a residence of exceptional quality that is ready for immediate occupation.

Designed to accommodate every aspect of modern family living, the property boasts an impressive array of premium features, including extra-high ceiling heights, triple-glazed windows, an A-rated BER, a beautifully private west-facing rear garden and a second reception room. Every detail has been carefully considered to deliver a home of remarkable quality, where sophisticated interiors are complemented by practical family-friendly spaces.

The ground floor is both welcoming and beautifully proportioned, with elegant herringbone flooring flowing seamlessly throughout. A generous entrance hall sets the tone, leading to a refined living room which opens effortlessly into the stunning open-plan kitchen and dining area at the rear—the true heart of the home. Bathed in natural light and opening through French doors to the sunny rear garden, this space has been designed with both relaxed family living and stylish entertaining in mind. A separate family room to the front provides valuable additional accommodation, ideal as a snug, playroom or home office, while a well-appointed utility room and guest WC complete the ground floor.

Upstairs, the impressive sense of space continues with four generously proportioned bedrooms, each benefiting from bespoke built-in wardrobes. The luxurious principal suite enjoys a beautifully finished en-suite bathroom, while two further double bedrooms, a spacious single bedroom and an elegantly appointed family bathroom complete the first-floor accommodation.

Outside, the beautifully landscaped west-facing rear garden offers a peaceful and private sanctuary, perfectly positioned to enjoy sunshine throughout the afternoon and into the evening. To the front, a landscaped garden and private off-street parking further enhance the property's exceptional kerb appeal.

Ballygossan Park is an exclusive modern development, perfectly positioned within walking distance of Skerries' superb range of amenities. Residents enjoy an exceptional lifestyle with excellent schools, cafés, restaurants, boutique shopping and the magnificent sandy beaches for which the town is renowned. Skerries Train Station is approximately a 12-minute walk away, providing regular rail services to Dublin City Centre, while excellent bus services, Dublin Airport and the M1 motorway are all easily accessible.

One of North Dublin's most desirable coastal towns, Skerries is celebrated for its vibrant community, picturesque harbour and outstanding recreational amenities. Sailing, golf, rugby, GAA, tennis and scenic coastal walks are all on your doorstep, creating an enviable balance of seaside tranquillity and everyday convenience.

Beautifully presented, impeccably maintained and finished to an exceptional specification, this outstanding residence offers a rare opportunity to acquire a home of genuine distinction in one of North Dublin's most prestigious coastal settings. Simply unpack, settle in and enjoy a lifestyle of comfort, elegance and convenience.
